Results.ReviewText:
Quality not there. It is a flimsy grill considering my previous Weber grill was much sturdier. It was not as well made or as sturdy as i was expecting from Weber. The grease tray and the way the grease filters down is not set up for easy cleaning. I do not like it at all. I spent $600 on it & thought it would be sturdier. The grilling bars are cheap & not ceramic as my old grill. I thought $600 was enough to spend in it but I was wrong.  
Unfortunately, $600 doesn’t buy quality with Weber. Very disappointed! I do not recommend purchasing this model.
Results.Title: Flimsy grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is much better than my previous 9 yr old Spirit. This one gets much hotter, faster. It cleans up easier too. I have added the 1/2 flat top grill and that alone makes this a much more versatile platform for cooking. I’m using it much more than my old Weber and I could not be happier with the cooking part of this. My only complaint would be the wheels. Really? You couldn’t go casters on all four legs? The plastic wheels are just cheap. Please do better on the next model for those of us that are looking for a small 2-person grill. Otherwise this has been a fine purchase for us and we are enjoying it
Results.Title: Love the grill

Results.ReviewText:
Having owned a Weber gas grill for the last, um, 20-ish years, I have very high expectations for this one.  However, I unexpectedly had this grill suddenly 'quit'.  I thought it was my tank so I got another tank thinking the it was empty.  When that tank failed as well, knowing it was full, I surmised that the tank valve was faulty since this grill was essentially brand new.  The Weber customer service reps (plural) that I spoke to led me through some troubleshooting steps and decided that the regulator should be replaced.  Turns out that the grill's regulator had failed.  I had purchased this grill from Lowe's and it was pre-assembled when I purchased it.  In hindsight, I am not sure that the regulator on the original grill was actually new but one never really knows.
Still a great grill, with fold up/down shelves that we wanted for a small deck.  Read the other reviews before you purchase one.  As of this writing everything is now working as advertised.
Results.Title: Great except for one thing

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second Webber Spirit grill. I was very pleased with my previous Spirit with the exception of the rusting out of the wheels from the base. I was happy to receive and assemble my replacement Spirit grill. Unfortunately, when I first tried to use it, I found the right control knob difficult to turn. The more I tried to turn it the more difficult it became. It froze in place and stripped the inside of the control knob. I eventually reached Fabiano at Webber and described the problem. He asked if I would try to turn what he referred to as the pin that the control knob fit onto with my fingers. I explained I had tried that to no effect. Eventually he asked me to send him a video of the problem. After several frustrating communications via unsuccessful calls and emails I asked to speak with his supervisor.  Whoever he referred it to, understood the problem and accepted our description, agreed to send out the replacement parts. Dealing with Fabiano was very frustrating. Yesterday we received the replacement parts as promised. I will attempt to replace the damaged parts using the replacement parts. 
Dealing with Fabiano was difficult and upsetting. It was like he did not believe me when I described the problem. It should not have been that difficult or take so long to correct the problem. 
I now look forward to replacing the parts and enjoying the use of my new Spirit grill.
Results.Title: Defective Searing Control Manifold

Results.ReviewText: Have only bought Weber grills over last 30 years.  New grill is my 3rd.  Seems solid to start.  Don't like some of the product design changes though on most recent.  The ignition process on new grills is very awkward and much harder to see if had lines are ignited.  The new 'boost' temperature mode is just useless.  I don't care for the switch from 3 vertical gas lines to horizontal... Liked being able to manage front to back vs right to left.  I do like new underneath cabinet storage of gas tank.
